name: Mr Bean's Internet
summary: Mackay/Whitsundays dialup + ADSL ISP (Mr Bean's Internet, 1998, Chariot netconnect reseller); ABN matches Chariot Limited; brand later served Chariot netconnect.

events.details: Named in Chariot's four-ISP acquisition announcement (12 Mar 2003): 'Mr Bean Internet the Mackay market'. Mr Bean's Internet was a Chariot netconnect reseller before being formally acquired (per existing DB summary); ABN matched Chariot Limited.
